items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: He played something on the art of Wayne King.

ctx.x: He knew the instrument all right.

He knew the instrument. A good ear. And a good fella to get along with. He was, he and Buddy Bowling and them used to play the gap. So when Buddy would play his trumpet and he'd take that dirt, which is what the people are known nowadays. He used to wear a doi be all the time in the street. That was a style. It's like what Sharky is doing now. I can tell you plenty about old Sharky too. It's like Buddy Bowling is the way that doi be in the street. And he'd leave him with his horn all the time. Buddy Bowling.…
How big a cup was it? Like a little can cup or what? Just them little ordinary cups. He just made like a little tin can. He made it. Yeah like a tin can. Yes. Ordinary cups.
